"''A positive development, sir. The dimensions of the conflict have diminished sufficiently that mining has resumed on the occupied lands.|Major Partagaz and Supervisor Lagret|}} '''Arvala-6''',''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' or '''Arvala-Six''', was a terrestrial astronomical object in the [[Arvala system]] in the [[Sevetta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It and the neighboring [[planet]] [[Arvala-7]] were considered to be on the frontier,{{Databank|arvala-7|Arvala-7}} and the [[Galactic Empire]] occupied its lands in order to [[Mining|mine]] resources. During the [[Imperial Era]], Arvala-6 was the site of a [[Arvala-6 conflict|conflict]], which had diminished in scale enough for mining operations to resume in the Imperial-controlled lands in [[5 BBY]].{{AndorDate|104}} [[Supervisor]] [[Lagret]] reported to a meeting of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] this information, to which [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz|Partagaz]] chastised Lagret for failing to finish a memorandum of recommendations for storage issues regarding displaced people. Lagret informed Partagaz that he was awaiting an assessment from Arvala-6's [[Arvala-6's ministerial director|ministerial director]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' {{1stID|Arvala-6}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Arvala-Seis |ja=アーヴァラ6 |ka=არვალა-6 |pl=Arvala-6 }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Slice]] [[Category:Galactic Empire astronomical objects]] [[Category:Mining areas]] [[Category:Sevetta sector locations]]
